name: Long-Range Photography
description: A high-zoom camera allows you to document target details from a safe standoff distance without raising suspicion. This is particularly valuable for capturing badge designs, access control hardware model numbers (which reveal bypass techniques), security camera models, and employee behavior around entry points. A polarized filter significantly reduces glare when shooting through glass or at reflective surfaces, and can reveal interior details like badge readers or reception desk layouts.

blue.det: Individual with telephoto lens or spotting scope aimed at facility; unusual vehicle parked with line of sight to entry points or sensitive areas.
blue.cm: Landscaping and physical barriers limiting line-of-sight to sensitive areas; frosted or one-way glass on ground-floor windows; awareness training for security staff to report suspicious surveillance.
